purpose: Test the mechanistic counterfactual that preserving otherwise-eligible PCORnet stroke diagnoses with missing diagnosis dates by assigning the linked encounter admission date as the target condition date is sufficient to restore source-faithful Stage C phenotype reproducibility and downstream Stage D 30-day/90-day analytical reproducibility.

relationship_to_completed_analyses.primary_stage_c: Already known before this sensitivity was defined; remains the primary source-faithful portability analysis.
relationship_to_completed_analyses.harmonized_dxdate_sensitivity: Already known before this sensitivity was defined; applies the opposite intervention by excluding missing-diagnosis-date source evidence before patient-level selection.
relationship_to_completed_analyses.primary_stage_d: Already known before this sensitivity was defined; remains the primary analytical-equivalence analysis.
relationship_to_completed_analyses.post_result_mechanism_audits: The source-only outcome complement audit and harmonization transition audits were already known before this sensitivity was defined.
relationship_to_completed_analyses.fallback_results: Unknown when this definition is committed. No fallback Stage C or Stage D result may be used to revise this definition.

alternative_target_date_policy.scope: Qualifying PCORnet DIAGNOSIS records used by the locked D0/D1/D3 ischemic-stroke phenotypes. All non-date phenotype rules remain unchanged.

date_rule.condition: DX_DATE is missing and the linked qualifying encounter has ADMIT_DATE

alternative_target_date_policy.discharge_date_fallback: Not used. The locked D0/D1/D3 encounter definition already requires ADMIT_DATE and DISCHARGE_DATE, so ADMIT_DATE is available for every qualifying episode and is the first encounter-date fallback used by the source-faithful index rule.
alternative_target_date_policy.provenance_requirement: Every alternative target diagnosis event must retain whether its date came from the recorded diagnosis date or encounter-admission fallback.
alternative_target_date_policy.non_date_etl_rules: Retain the frozen transformation's person/visit linkage, vocabulary mapping, concept-zero policy where applicable, source identity/provenance, and all other transformation rules. The sensitivity changes only diagnosis-date eligibility/date assignment for otherwise-eligible DIAGNOSIS records.
alternative_target_date_policy.implementation_isolation: Implement only in session-local temporary tables, a dedicated sensitivity schema, or equivalent non-destructive overlay. Do not insert, update, or delete rows in the frozen OMOP_VALIDATED_A target tables and do not rerun the frozen ETL in place.

stage_c_analysis.source_comparator: Reconstruct the locked source-faithful D0/D1/D3 cohorts without changing source rules.
stage_c_analysis.fallback_target: Construct lineage-faithful alternative target stroke evidence under the alternative target date policy, then apply the locked D0/D1/D3 patient-level episode selection rules.
stage_c_analysis.all_other_rules: Retain the locked stroke code lists, PDX=P, encounter types, overnight rule, adult rule, imaging definitions, lipid whitelist, evidence windows, earliest-qualifying-episode selection, and target procedure/lipid evidence rules.
estimands: D0 source and fallback-target patient counts
D0 intersection, source-only, fallback-only, Jaccard, exact index-date agreement, and within-1-day agreement
D1 source and fallback-target patient counts, intersection, discordant membership, Jaccard, and index-date agreement
D3 source and fallback-target patient counts, intersection, discordant membership, Jaccard, and index-date agreement
For each phenotype, counts of selected fallback target episodes using recorded_diagnosis_date versus encounter_admission_date_fallback
stage_c_analysis.fallback_target_expected_counts: Not prespecified. The analysis must report observed values even if they do not converge to the source counts.

stage_d_analysis.index_cohorts: Compare the unchanged locked source-faithful D0 cohort with the independently selected fallback-target D0 cohort from this sensitivity.
stage_d_analysis.outcome_definition: Inherit the locked Stage D acute-care reutilization definitions exactly; no outcome-event transformation rule changes are allowed.
windows: day 1 through day 30 after index discharge, inclusive
day 1 through day 90 after index discharge, inclusive
stage_d_analysis.observability: Use the same representation-specific source ENROLLMENT and target observation_period coverage rules as the locked Stage D analysis.
metrics: absolute risk difference in percentage points
whether the existing empirical cross-CDM reproducibility tolerances are met
stage_d_analysis.recurrent_stroke: Not rerun in this sensitivity unless separately justified and locked before execution.
stage_d_analysis.stage_e_models: Not rerun in this sensitivity unless Stage C/Stage D fallback results create a separately justified question that is locked before model execution.

precommitted_interpretation_branches.stage_c_exact_convergence: If fallback-target D0/D1/D3 membership and selected index dates reproduce the source-faithful cohorts exactly, interpret this as evidence that the diagnosis-date policy is sufficient to explain the observed lineage-faithful Stage C discordance under this alternative-date sensitivity. Do not describe the fallback policy as the uniquely correct ETL.
precommitted_interpretation_branches.stage_c_membership_only_convergence: If membership converges but index dates do not, report the residual date discordance separately and do not claim full mechanistic closure.
precommitted_interpretation_branches.stage_c_residual_membership_discordance: If any membership discordance remains, quantify and decompose it rather than attributing all primary Stage C differences to the diagnosis-date policy.
precommitted_interpretation_branches.stage_d_convergence: If 30-day and 90-day end-to-end risks meet both inherited empirical tolerances, interpret this as evidence that restoring missing-date source stroke evidence under the alternative date policy is sufficient to remove the previously observed end-to-end risk divergence in this dataset.
precommitted_interpretation_branches.stage_d_nonconvergence: If either window fails either inherited tolerance, report the residual difference and investigate remaining cohort-selection, observability, or outcome-representation mechanisms without revising this sensitivity definition post hoc.
precommitted_interpretation_branches.combined_mechanistic_reading: Convergence of both the restrictive harmonized sensitivity and the preservative fallback sensitivity would provide two directionally opposite mechanistic checks pointing to diagnosis-date handling as the principal driver of the primary cohort divergence.
